ext_description.message: Capture posts into BRUV cards and slide decks

dialog_video_link_note.message: The slide plays from the platform's link, which can stop working later.

dialog_link_note.message: Not stored in BRUV; platform links expire.

dialog_include_deck.message: Add a slide to this deck

dialog_deck_hint.message: Pick a deck target in the BRUV Clipper popup first.

dialog_note_no_preview.message: BRUV's server didn't answer in time, so there are no size estimates from it. The capture still runs here, from this page.

dialog_note_unsupported.message: BRUV's server has no reader for this site — a link shared from your phone would land as a plain link card. This capture reads the page directly, so the post lands in full.

dialog_note_blocked.message: {platform} blocks BRUV's server (a link shared from your phone would land as a pending clip). This capture reads the page in your logged-in browser, so it lands complete — but sizes below come from this page only.

dialog_note_embed.message: The slide plays this with the platform's own embedded player — no video file is stored.

dialog_note_video_large.message: The pre-selected video quality is about {size}. Pick a smaller one below if you'd rather not store that.

dialog_note_video_budget.message: This video is about {size} even at its smallest quality — over the {budget} MB budget in your capture defaults — so nothing is pre-selected to store. Pick a quality below to store it anyway; your browser can download it even when BRUV's server can't.

dialog_note_no_video.message: This post's video couldn't be resolved, so only its poster image is available.

toast_clipped_no_pin.message: Clipped, but couldn't pin — the card is in the Inbox. Check the pin target in Options (the category may not accept this card type, or belongs to another vault).

toast_queued.message: Server unreachable — clip queued, will retry

toast_failed.message: Clip failed — see the extension console

toast_not_paired.message: BRUV Clipper isn't paired yet — open its options

toast_no_deck.message: No deck target set — pick one in the BRUV Clipper popup

toast_no_plugin.message: Nothing clippable on this site yet

toast_no_unit.message: Couldn't find a post here — right-click directly on one

popup_not_paired.message: Not paired with a BRUV server.

popup_offline.message: Can't reach BRUV at {url}. Deck and pending clips are unavailable until it's back — for a local server, start the desktop app. Clips you make now are queued and sent automatically.

popup_no_deck.message: No deck selected — clips become cards only

popup_card_has_no_deck.message: That card has no slide deck block

popup_pending_deleted.message: Clip deleted. A slide added for it stays in its deck — remove it there.

popup_pending_error_no_tab.message: Couldn't open a tab for that clip

popup_pending_error_no_clip.message: Couldn't read the post on that page

options_bootstrap.message: Bootstrap token (from the server's bootstrap-token.txt / QR page)

options_paired_ok.message: Paired — now pick a repo below

options_pair_local.message: Pair automatically (this machine — no token needed)

options_detect.message: Find the server on this machine

options_detect_running.message: Looking for a BRUV server on this machine…

options_detected.message: Found BRUV {version} at {url} — now pair below.

options_detect_multi.message: Found BRUV servers on ports {ports} — using {url}. Edit the URL if you meant a different one.

options_detect_none.message: No BRUV server answered on ports 9870-9879. Start the desktop app (or bruv-server) and try again — if the app is set to a fixed port outside that range, type its URL instead (Settings → General → local server port).

options_err_url_and_token.message: Enter the server URL and a bootstrap token — or use "Pair automatically" for a server on this machine.

options_err_unreachable.message: Can't reach the BRUV server at {url}. For a local pairing, make sure the desktop app (or the BRUV service) is running — the local server stops with the app, and its port can change if the fixed port was taken at startup.

options_category_stale.message: The saved pin target doesn't exist in this repo — clips will land in the Inbox until you pick a new one.

options_category_deck.message: Same location(s) as the deck target
